headline: Pulev: The country is going through a difficult period due to accumulated deficit
summary: Bulgaria's government announced a package of measures worth 2 billion euros to support households, industry and non-household energy consumers. Prime Minister-level comments cited an accumulated deficit.
why: Bulgaria is an EU member with public finances under scrutiny, so large support packages affect its deficit, bond outlook and energy costs.
